clue.text: Feral child cut head off fruit

parts.note: to mow is to cut grass

indicators.note: the fruit's name loses its first letter, its head

parts.note: the ugli is a citrus fruit, a tangelo hybrid

explanation.surface: Someone lops the top off a piece of fruit, with a wild child somewhere in the background.
explanation.definitionFit: The boy raised by wolves in Kipling's Jungle Book is literature's best-known feral child.

clue.text: Shooting star swapping energy for a boozer's figure of speech

indicators.note: swapping one thing for another: the second E of the star word is taken out and the new letters put in its place

parts.note: a shooting star is a meteor
E is the physics symbol for energy
a boozer is a pub, PH being the map abbreviation for public house

explanation.surface: A drinker gazes at a meteor and turns it into a poetic image.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swapping energy for' replaces the second E of METEOR with A plus PH.
explanation.definitionFit: A metaphor is a rhetorical device describing one thing in terms of another, a classic figure of speech.

clue.text: Lexicographer's mother introduced to IT supremo

indicators.note: one piece is introduced into the middle of the other, so it is placed inside

parts.note: Noah Webster compiled the great American dictionary
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A dictionary-maker's mum is brought in to meet the head of computing.
explanation.definitionFit: The person in charge of a website is its master, a supremo of that corner of information technology.

clue.text: Come off worse and end with no beginning

indicators.note: the word for end is cut short at its front, losing its opening letter

parts.note: a close is an end, as in the close of day

explanation.surface: Advice on how to fail: be beaten, and finish without ever starting.
explanation.definitionFit: To come off worse in a contest is to be beaten in it, the opposite of winning.

clue.text: Secret tippler frequenting endlessly spooky clubs

indicators.note: a drinker who frequents a place is found inside it, so one piece sits within the other
the word for spooky loses its last letter

parts.note: eerie means spooky
a sot is a habitual drinker
C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games

explanation.surface: A furtive drinker haunts some creepy nightclubs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'frequenting' looks like it only colours the drinker's habits, but it is the container signal, and 'endlessly' trims the spooky word.
explanation.definitionFit: Esoteric knowledge is understood only by an inner circle, so it is secret or arcane.

clue.text: Lag behind good person and good composer standing up outside

parts.note: ST, for saint, is the crossword good person

indicators.note: the turned composer goes round the other piece, outside it
in a down clue standing up means the word is read from the bottom upward, backwards

parts.note: Edward Elgar was an English composer

explanation.surface: A worthy person and a fine composer rise to their feet while one dawdles at the back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standing up' turns ELGAR to RAGLE; 'outside' wraps it round G to make RAG-G-LE.
explanation.definitionFit: To straggle is to trail behind the main group, falling back from it.

clue.text: Medium for which one English novelist might be adapted

indicators.note: adapting a book changes its form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A broadcasting medium suited to adapting a work by a single English writer.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters are I, E and NOVELIST.
explanation.definitionFit: Broadcast viewing is a mass medium of communication, like radio or the press.

clue.text: Royal oven and what to do with it

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for royal, as in RN
an oast is a kiln for drying hops, a kind of oven

explanation.surface: A grand kitchen oven, with a hint on how to use it.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition refers back to the oven: the thing one does with an oven is cook meat in it this way.
explanation.definitionFit: Cooking food in dry heat inside an oven is the usual task the appliance performs.

clue.text: Most smart: assay copper first

indicators.note: first places the copper symbol ahead of the testing word

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
to assay a metal is to test it

explanation.surface: Instructions for the cleverest metallurgist: analyse the copper before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: Cute can mean shrewd or clever, so the superlative gives most smart.

clue.text: Sounded alarm: poison!

indicators.note: sounded signals that a word is spoken, and the entry is something that is heard the same

parts.note: a tocsin is an alarm bell

explanation.surface: Someone raises the alarm with a cry of poison.
explanation.definitionFit: A biological poison produced by a living organism, such as a venom, fits the noun.

clue.text: Scholars tucked into pancake with sauce

indicators.note: being tucked into something means sitting inside it

parts.note: a taco is a folded Mexican flatbread, loosely a pancake
BAs are holders of the Bachelor of Arts degree, scholars

explanation.surface: Students tuck into a pancake with a dash of hot sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: The fiery Louisiana pepper sauce is a well-known brand of condiment.

clue.text: Trusting unstable latrine

indicators.note: something unstable falls apart, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone has too much faith in a wobbly toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: Being reliant on something means depending on it, trusting it to hold.

clue.text: Friend entertaining drug ring

indicators.note: a host entertaining a guest holds them within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a pal is a friend
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A mate plays host to a drugs gang.
explanation.definitionFit: A peal is a ringing of bells, so the noun ring fits as a sound.

clue.text: Problem with gum — is it giving out?

indicators.note: out here means put out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dental worry: is the gum about to give way?
explanation.definitionFit: This is inflammation of the tissue around the teeth, a common dental problem.

clue.text: Economic thinker, painter and loveless toff

parts.note: Claude Monet was the French Impressionist painter

indicators.note: love is O in tennis scoring, so the toff word loses that letter

parts.note: an aristo, short for aristocrat, is a toff

explanation.surface: A list of types: an economist, an artist, and a nobleman lacking affection.
explanation.definitionFit: An economist who holds that controlling the money supply governs inflation follows Milton Friedman's school.

clue.text: Prove wilier, supplying neat wrapping for dodgy tofu

indicators.note: one piece wraps round the other, enclosing it

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle, so an ox

indicators.note: dodgy suggests something not right, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone outwits a rival by serving beef wrapped round suspect bean curd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neat' is the old word for cattle, not tidy or undiluted; 'dodgy' scrambles the bean curd before the beast wraps round it.
explanation.definitionFit: To outfox someone is to beat them by cunning, being more crafty than they are.

clue.text: Remedy involving large — initially very large — resolution

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the remedy holds the other letters inside

parts.note: a cure is a remedy
OS, the abbreviation for outsize, stands as initials for something very large

explanation.surface: A treatment taking in something big, then something very big, brings a resolution.
explanation.definitionFit: Closure is the sense of an issue being settled or brought to an end, a resolution.

clue.text: Lout gutted hen wearing make-up, and gutted chick

indicators.note: the bird's remains are inside the make-up, wearing it

parts.note: rouge is red cosmetic make-up

indicators.note: gutted means the insides of the word hen are removed, leaving its outer letters
again the insides of the word chick are removed, leaving only its ends

explanation.surface: A grisly kitchen scene: a disembowelled hen in cosmetics beside a gutted chick.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'gutted' signals strip a bird name to its first and last letters, and 'wearing' puts the first bird inside the cosmetic.
explanation.definitionFit: A roughneck is a rough, uncouth person, a thug or lout.

clue.text: Big cat almost appearing in temple

indicators.note: almost means the big cat word stops one letter short

parts.note: a panther is a big cat
on means appearing, as a performer on stage

explanation.surface: A leopard nearly turns up inside a temple.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pantheon in Rome is a temple to all the gods, and the word means such a temple.

clue.text: Feeling ecstatic about new obligation

indicators.note: the ecstatic word goes about, around, the other letters

parts.note: sent is old slang for transported or ecstatic
a tie is a binding obligation

explanation.surface: A person is thrilled about taking on a fresh commitment.
explanation.definitionFit: Sentient means able to perceive or feel, so the adjective feeling fits.

clue.text: Major road offering small return in conflict

indicators.note: in places the returned word inside the conflict word

parts.note: a fray is a fight or conflict

indicators.note: return means the word for small is read backwards

parts.note: wee is Scottish for small

explanation.surface: A highway gives little payback amid the fighting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns WEE to EEW, and 'in' puts it into FRAY: FR-EEW-AY.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage a freeway is a multi-lane highway, a major road.

clue.text: Course of foreign shellfish including squid's tail

indicators.note: the shellfish word includes, holds within, the other letter

parts.note: moule is French for mussel

indicators.note: the tail of the word squid is its last letter

explanation.surface: A French seafood platter with the end of a squid thrown in.
explanation.definitionFit: A module is a unit of study within a degree, one course among several.

clue.text: Senior ecclesiastic babes travelling south

indicators.note: travelling suggests moving about, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A senior nun watches young women heading southwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a convent of nuns is a senior figure in the church.

clue.text: Insects, or what they did going up

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means reading from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: stang is an archaic past tense of sting, which is what biting insects did

explanation.surface: Insects and their habits, viewed as they fly upwards.
explanation.walkthrough: STANG is an old form of 'stung'.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnats are small two-winged flies, a kind of insect.

clue.text: Soldier turning to another in sea ship

indicators.note: in places the soldier letters inside the sea word

parts.note: brine is salt water, the sea

indicators.note: turning means the soldier's letters are read backwards

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
another soldier: a soldier ant is a kind of ant

explanation.surface: A sailor-soldier swaps to another vessel out on the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' means another soldier, the soldier ant; 'turning' makes GI into IG, and 'in' puts IGANT into BRINE.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigantine is a two-masted sailing vessel, a type of ship.

clue.text: Bury decapitated playwright

indicators.note: decapitated means the head, the first letter, is cut off

parts.note: Harold Pinter was an English playwright

explanation.surface: A grim instruction to inter a beheaded dramatist.
explanation.definitionFit: To inter is to place a body in a grave, a formal synonym for burying.

clue.text: Attempt to photograph

definitions.meaning: a go or try, as in having a ... at something
a picture taken with a camera, a snap

explanation.surface: Having a go at taking a picture.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a try at something and a single photographic image.

clue.text: Ancient queen acted with love

parts.note: did means acted or performed
love is zero, O, in tennis

explanation.surface: An old queen behaved affectionately.
explanation.definitionFit: Dido was the legendary founding queen of Carthage, lover of Aeneas.

clue.text: Braid net, befuddled by drink

indicators.note: by means beside, so the drink sits next to the jumbled letters
befuddled means confused, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: wine is a drink

explanation.surface: Someone tries to plait a net while tipsy.
explanation.definitionFit: To entwine strands is to twist them together, as one does in braiding hair.

clue.text: First to row in weary setter's boat

indicators.note: in places the opening letter inside the weary word

parts.note: to tire is to grow weary

indicators.note: first to means the leading letter of the word row

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: The puzzle-maker, worn out, starts rowing an old galley.
explanation.definitionFit: A trireme was an ancient Greek warship with three banks of oars, a boat.

clue.text: Science and sport given minute examination

parts.note: SC is an abbreviation for science
RU stands for Rugby Union, a sport
minute, pronounced my-NEWT, means tiny

explanation.surface: Scientific and sporting matters are given a close inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrutiny is close, careful inspection of something, an examination.

clue.text: Vegetable to shoot up

definitions.meaning: a peppery salad leaf, also called arugula
to climb steeply and fast, as prices do

explanation.surface: A vegetable that grows fast.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a salad leaf and also means to rise very quickly.
